changeSet.author: jcarvaja
changeSet.comment: Normalize the subscriptions and subscription_measurements tables in h2, so the state is the same as the ones in PostgreSQL. Therefore, we can run the migration for both.

changeSet.author: jcarvaja
changeSet.comment: Migrate subscription PK from (subscription_id, start_date) to (subscription_number, start_date); align measurements FK/PK; nullable subscription_id
changeSet.sql:
DELETE FROM subscription_measurements WHERE subscription_number IS NULL OR TRIM(subscription_number) = '' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subscription s WHERE s.subscription_id = subscription_measurements.subscription_id AND s.start_date = subscription_measurements.start_date AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subscription keeper WHERE keeper.subscription_number = s.subscription_number AND keeper.start_date = s.start_date AND keeper.subscription_id > s.subscription_id ) );
DELETE FROM subscription WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subscription keeper WHERE keeper.subscription_number = subscription.subscription_number AND keeper.start_date = subscription.start_date AND keeper.subscription_id > subscription.subscription_id );

changeSet.author: jcarvaja
changeSet.createView: with active_subscriptions as ( select org_id, subscription_number, MAX(start_date) as start_date from subscription where start_date <= now() and (end_date is null or end_date >= now()) group by org_id, subscription_number ) select s.subscription_number, s.sku, o.has_unlimited_usage, o.description as product_name, coalesce(o.sla, '') as service_level, coalesce(o.usage, '') as usage, s.org_id, s.billing_provider, s.billing_provider_id, s.billing_account_id, s.start_date, s.end_date, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('metric_id',sm.metric_id,'value', sm.value, 'measurement_type', sm.measurement_type)) as metrics, spt.product_tag, s.quantity as quantity from active_subscriptions a inner join subscription s on a.subscription_number = s.subscription_number and a.start_date = s.start_date and a.org_id = s.org_id inner join offering o on s.sku = o.sku inner join sku_product_tag spt on s.sku = spt.sku left join subscription_measurements sm on s.subscription_number = sm.subscription_number and s.start_date = sm.start_date group by s.subscription_number, s.sku, o.has_unlimited_usage, o.description, o.sla, o.usage, s.org_id, s.billing_provider, s.billing_provider_id, s.billing_account_id, spt.product_tag, s.quantity, s.start_date, s.end_date

changeSet.author: jcarvaja
changeSet.createView: select distinct s.subscription_number, s.sku, o.has_unlimited_usage, o.description as product_name, o.sla as service_level, o.usage, s.org_id, s.billing_provider, s.billing_provider_id, s.billing_account_id, s.start_date, s.end_date, CONCAT('[{"metric_id":"', sm.metric_id, '","value":',COALESCE(sm.value,0), ',"measurement_type":"',sm.measurement_type , '"}]') as metrics, spt.product_tag, s.quantity as quantity from subscription s inner join offering o on s.sku=o.sku inner join sku_product_tag spt on s.sku = spt.sku left join subscription_measurements sm on s.subscription_number = sm.subscription_number and s.start_date = sm.start_date where s.start_date <= now() and (s.end_date is null or s.end_date >= now()) group by s.subscription_number, s.sku, o.has_unlimited_usage, o.description, o.sla, o.usage , s.org_id, s.billing_provider, s.billing_provider_id, s.billing_account_id, spt.product_tag,s.quantity, sm.metric_id, sm.value, sm.measurement_type, s.start_date, s.end_date order by s.subscription_number asc
